title: Add new release repositories
author: facontidavide
body:
* Name of the release team: facontidavide

* Release repositories to add:

  * [facontidavide/cloudini](https://github.com/facontidavide/cloudini)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/master/rolling/distribution.yaml#L1146)

comments.author: cottsay
comments.body:
This has been deployed: https://github.com/ros2-gbp/cloudini-release

I recommend updating all ROS distributions to use the new release repositories under `ros2-gbp` so that all of the distributions are in the same place, at which time you may decommission the existing release repo.
